50 Cent Recants Trump Support After Chelsea Handler Offers Him Sex
Gabriel Hays
October 26th, 2020 12:50 PM
Text to Speech
00:00
00:00
Font Size
We were mistaken for thinking that 50 Cent would live up to his tough-as-nails image and vote Trump despite the haters. The “Get Rich or Die Tryin’” rapper decided that “another spin” with ex-girlfriend Chelsea Handler was better than paying much less in taxes under President Donald Trump.
The rapper reneged on his support for the president after being
berated
by the crass lefty comedian for being black and not voting for Biden, and on top of that racist humiliation, Handler sweetened the pot by offering him another chance at dating her.
And to think these rappers constantly rhyme about prioritizing money over romance. 50’s going soft, clearly.
Hip-hop mogul, actor and “In Da Club
”
rapper 50 Cent
broke
the internet last week when he posted to social media that he would be voting for President Trump after viewing Biden’s dismal tax plan. 50 – whose real name is Curtis James Jackson III – famously quipped that under Biden he’d have to change his name to “20 Cent” to mirror the amount he’d have to pay in taxes.
Cent claimed, “I don’t care Trump doesn’t like black people 62% are you out of ya f---ing mind,” in reference to Biden’s heavy tax plan for Americans who earn over $400,000 a year.
Cent’s lefty ex-girlfriend Chelsea Handler could not abide by this bit of free will from the rapper, and took it upon herself to remind him that he’s not allowed to vote for Trump and influence a “swath” of other people to do so as well.
In a late night
interview
on
The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon
over the weekend, Handler complained that her ex-boyfriend would vote for Trump. She told the NBC host, “He says he doesn’t wanna pay 62% in taxes – which by the way isn’t a plan of Joe Biden’s, that’s a lie.”
In addition to calling the rapper a liar, Handler got real offensive with her comments, stooping low to say that as a black man, 50 Cent should be voting for Biden. “He doesn’t wanna go from being 50 Cent to ‘20 Cent’ and I had to remind him that he was a black person, so he can’t vote for Donald Trump, and that he shouldn’t be influencing an entire swath of people.”
Wow, looks like Joe Biden’s “You ain’t black!” comment has become an essential DNC talking point. Talk about racist. Also, didn’t Handler have a Netflix show where she apologized for her white
privilege
? Her lecturing 50 Cent on who to vote for based on his skin color is more than privilege, it’s practically supremacist.
That wasn’t where the insult ended from the nasty woman. She baited Cent sexually as well, saying, “I haven’t heard back from him yet but I am willing to, you know, seal the deal in more ways than one if he changes his mind and publicly denounce his Donald Trump [support]. I might be willing to go for another spin, if you know what I’m talking about.” Gross.
👀a what, 😳another spin 💫Fu*k Donald Trump, I never liked him. 🤨for all I know he had me set up and had my friend Angel Fernandez killed but that’s history. LOL
@chelseahandler
@jimmyfallon
pic.twitter.com/Tya6EqDBFt
— 50cent (@50cent)
October 25, 2020
Apparently that was the trick that brought the errant rapper to heel. He retweeted video of Handler’s comments and commented on them,
writing
, “a what. another spin. Fu*k Donald Trump, I never liked him. for all I know he had me set up and had my friend Angel Fernandez killed but that’s history. LOL @chelseahandler @jimmyfallon.”
Handler responded, asking whether 50 would commit to a Biden vote. She
tweeted
, “does this tweet me we can count on a vote for you for @JoeBiden? I’m happy to discuss this with you privately.”
So much for 50’s money moves. The manipulative, racist wench was able to extort his baser instincts and his skin color for her own political gain. And African Americans think the left cares about them?
